name: Bad North: Jotunn Edition
short_description: Defend tiny island kingdoms from Viking longships with a handful of squads.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Defend tiny island kingdoms from Viking longships with a handful of squads.

identity.core_loop: See boats coming, move squads to the shore, hold, retreat, upgrade, sail to the next island.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Calm, tense, tidy; a whole battle on a toy island.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Boats are visible on the sea before they land; squads are banners on the island; almost no numbers. Islands go red with blood, sparingly.

identity.art_direction: Minimal pastel islands, tiny soldiers, soft fog.

rendering.signature: Minimal pastel islands floating in a soft fog; the fog colour is the mood.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Fog is a shader too: its colour sets the mood before anything else.

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: A small floating island diorama with almost no HUD is exactly our tile look; threats arrive where you can see them.
